title: Telecaller Jobs in Ameerpet, Hyderabad at Mokshith Sai Solutions
description:
**Job Requirements**
**Job Title/Post Title: Telecaller (Female)**
 Company Name: Mokshith Sai Solutions
   

  

 Location: Ameerpet, Hyderabad
   

  

 Qualification: 12th Pass
   

  

 Experience: Any experience
   

  

 Salary: 12,000 \- 18,000 monthly
   

  

**Job Description**
 Telecaller (Female) positions are now open at Mokshith Sai Solutions in Ameerpet, Hyderabad. This full\-time, office\-based role is perfect for freshers and experienced candidates alike who are fluent in Telugu and possess basic English skills.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Handling inbound and outbound calls in a professional manner
* Providing detailed information about the company’s products and services to potential customers
* Recording customer information accurately in the system
* Following up with customers to ensure satisfaction and resolve any issues
* Meeting daily, weekly, and monthly targets set by the management
* Participating in training sessions to improve skills and performance
* Collaborating with team members to achieve better results


**Benefits**
* Fixed monthly salary of 12,000 \- 15,000 with an average of 3,000 in incentives
* Potential to earn up to 18,000 or more with good performance
* Day shift working hours
* Opportunity to work in a supportive and dynamic environment
* Career growth and development opportunities within the company


**Additional Information**
* Work Location: Ameerpet, Hyderabad
* Employment Type: Full Time
* Shift: Day Shift
* Freshers are welcome to apply


**About Mokshith Sai Solutions**
 Mokshith Sai Solutions is a reputable company located in Ameerpet, Hyderabad, dedicated to providing excellent customer support and services. Join our team and be part of a growing organization that values its employees and offers a supportive work environment.
